desc: Ideate the solution using a two-pointer approach with a monotonic stack.
Use a stack `st` storing `(value, count)` representing segments of the non-decreasing sequence $b$.
Maintain `sum_b` (sum of $b_i$ for the current window) and `sum_nums` (sum of original `nums` for the current window).

Update the stack and `sum_b` to incorporate `nums[right]`. If `nums[right]` is smaller than the top of the stack, merge segments and adjust `sum_b` by adding the difference `(top.value - nums[right]) * count`.

Update the stack and `sum_b` to remove the effect of `nums[left-1]`. This involves popping segments if `nums[left-1]` was the maximum for that segment and redistributing the count/value to the next segment in the stack.
